statement: Preserve minus one when the character is absent.
assume: encoding >= 0 && encoding < 40 && needle >= 0 && needle < 4 && utfgrid.Search.expected(encoding, needle) == -1

adapter.mapping: Encoding 0 through 39 enumerates zero to three tokens from a, b and U+2070E in bijective base three, least significant token first. Needle 0, 1, 2 or 3 selects a, b, U+2070E or z. The runtime receiver argument is a StringBuilder.
